div.head: VIII Atr 10
div.ab: And Romfeoh gelæste man æghwilce geare be Petres mæssan.
And Romfeoh gelæste man æghwilce geare be Petres mæssan.
And Romfeoh gelæste man æghwilce geare be Petres mæssan.
Und Romgeld werde in jedem Jahre zu Petri Festtag entrichtet.
And let Rome-money be paid every year by St Peter's day.
And Peter's Pence shall be rendered every year by St Peter's Day.
And the dues to Rome are to be paid each year by the Feast of Saint Peter.
